title: Install XYTE CLI
prompt: Hey, install @xyteai/cli and make sure it runs.
focus: Get the CLI available globally in one command.

title: Install Agent Skills
prompt: Set this workspace up for AI agents.

title: Connect with API Key
prompt: Connect to my account using this API key.
command: XYTE_CLI_KEY=<key> xyte-cli setup run --non-interactive && xyte-cli setup status --format json
focus: Use tenant-bound key setup and confirm readiness.

title: Export PDF Report
prompt: Generate a fleet PDF report I can share with leadership.
command: xyte-cli inspect deep-dive --tenant <tenant-id> --window 24 --format json > deep-dive.json && xyte-cli report generate --tenant <tenant-id> --input deep-dive.json --out fleet-report.pdf
focus: Turn captured fleet/incident data into a shareable PDF handoff.
